qualifier: mitotic spindle orientation and positioning
name: Centrosome microtubule anchoring and mitotic spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome location, MTOC microtubule nucleation/anchoring and cortical cues that position and orient the spindle, unlike confusables about mitotic centrosome maturation, neuroblast division, centriole/cilium biogenesis or tubulin modification.

core: Inherited metabolic enzyme and transporter defects
qualifier: cytochrome P450 enzymes and solute transporters
name: Monogenic disorders of cytochrome P450 enzymes and transporters
rationale: All members are disease pathways caused by defective CYP enzymes or small-molecule transporters (ABCB6, SLC33A1, SLCO2A1, TBXAS1), whereas confusables centre on cholesterol, bile acid or eicosanoid metabolism itself.

qualifier: surface receptors and transporters
name: Monocyte and myeloid surface receptor signatures
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid surface and enrichment signatures plus monocyte activation and differentiation, distinguished from confusables on myeloid lineage specification, neutrophil degranulation, monocyte extravasation or dendritic cell signatures.

qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxynucleoside monophosphates
name: Pyrimidine and deoxynucleoside monophosphate catabolism
rationale: All members degrade pyrimidine nucleotides or deoxyribonucleoside monophosphates, unlike confusables focused on pyrimidine biosynthesis/salvage or purine deoxynucleoside metabolism.

core: Chaperone-mediated protein refolding and quality control
qualifier: under nitrosative and metal stress, limiting mitochondrial targeting
name: Chaperone refolding and protein quality control under cellular stress
rationale: Members cover chaperone refolding, ER folding, aggrephagy/CMA and inclusion control with stress responses and mitochondrial targeting restraint, unlike confusables on HSF1 heat shock, UPRmt or de novo folding.

qualifier: apoptotic cell recognition and phagocytic clearance
name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell phagocytic clearance
rationale: Members describe microglial differentiation, activation and DAP12 signaling together with recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, which confusables about astrocytes, glial apoptosis or amyloid clearance lack.

qualifier: phosphatidylinositol synthesis and phospholipid transfer
name: ER contact-site tethering and phosphatidylinositol lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tethering to mitochondria, plasma membrane and autophagosomes with intermembrane phospholipid transfer and PI/PIP synthesis, unlike confusables on ER tubule shaping or glycolipid/cholesterol vesicle transport.

qualifier: myofibroblast and fibrotic tissue replacement
name: Cardiac fibroblast differentiation and fibrotic connective tissue replacement
rationale: All three members concern cardiac fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement, distinct from cardiomyocyte growth, smooth muscle phenotypic switching or TGF-beta-restrained ECM confusables.

qualifier: replication- and repair-coupled assembly and disassembly
name: Nucleosome assembly and disassembly in replication and repair
rationale: Members cover replication-dependent chromatin assembly, protein-DNA complex disassembly, CHD remodeling and NER regulation, unlike confusables on BAF complex formation or centromeric CENP-A deposition and condensation.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 production and antigen presentation
name: Dendritic cell IL-12 production driving Th1 interferon-gamma responses
rationale: Members span DC cytokine (IL-12, GM-CSF) production, MHC upregulation, Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma response, whereas confusables emphasize IFNG receptor signaling, IL-12 JAK-STAT, CD8 or NKT cells.

qualifier: floor plate and ventral midline
name: Neural plate regionalization and floor plate development
rationale: Members concern neural plate/fold formation, neuroepithelial fate and floor plate/ventral midline development, unlike confusables on neural plate border specification or spinal cord and midbrain neuron patterning.

qualifier: ornithine, citrulline and arginine catabolism and regulation
name: Ornithine, citrulline and arginine metabolism linked to urea cycle
rationale: Members cover ornithine, citrulline, aspartate and arginine catabolism, mitochondrial ornithine transport and urea cycle enzyme repression, rather than the urea cycle enzymes and their deficiencies, glutamate/glutamine metabolism or cationic amino acid import.

qualifier: receptor clustering at both excitatory and inhibitory synapses
name: Postsynaptic receptor clustering at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
rationale: Members cluster NMDA, GABA receptors, PSD-95 and gephyrin and tune excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic potentials, while confusables centre on synaptic adhesion molecules and presynaptic assembly.

qualifier: AMPA, kainate and nicotinic ionotropic receptor activation
name: AMPA, kainate and nicotinic receptor-mediated excitatory synaptic transmission
rationale: Members describe activation and trapping of AMPA, kainate and nicotinic receptors with presynaptic depolarization in excitatory transmission, unlike confusables on presynaptic release modulation or inhibitory synapse assembly.

qualifier: transmitter-specific release cycles
name: Neurotransmitter-specific synaptic vesicle release cycles
rationale: Members are the release cycles for individual neurotransmitters plus vesicle docking, unlike confusables about regulation of exocytosis, priming and SNARE assembly.

qualifier: bundling, severing and filopodium regulation
name: Actin filament bundling, severing and filopodium regulation
rationale: Members cover actin crosslinking, parallel bundles, severing, capping and filopodium control (including EPHB, RHOF and postsynaptic actin), unlike confusables on lamellipodial motility or focal adhesion complexes.

qualifier: core enzymes and their inherited deficiencies
name: Urea cycle enzymes and their inherited deficiencies
rationale: Members are the urea cycle, arginine/citrulline synthesis and deficiencies of each cycle enzyme, unlike confusables on ornithine/arginine catabolism, transport or glutamate metabolism.

qualifier: DNA glycosylase function and inherited defects
name: Base excision repair and inherited DNA glycosylase defects
rationale: Members cover glycosylase recognition and cleavage, AP-site processing, gap filling and defective OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1/NEIL variants, unlike confusables on direct alkylation reversal or TET/TDG demethylation.

qualifier: catecholamines and serotonin, with sympathoadrenal development
name: Catecholamine and serotonin synthesis, degradation and sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members span catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis, MAO/COMT degradation and adrenal/sympathetic development, unlike confusables on monoamine transporters/uptake or BH4 cofactor synthesis.

qualifier: CDK4/6-RB axis and its cancer defects
name: G1/S checkpoint control by CDK4/6-RB and its cancer defects
rationale: Members concern cyclin D/CDK4/6, p16/p14ARF, RB1/E2F and p27/p21 control of G1/S and their cancer-associated defects, unlike confusables on senescence programs, TP53 transcriptional regulation or G2/M.

qualifier: modified lipoprotein uptake and foam cell formation
name: Scavenger receptor uptake of modified lipoproteins and foam cells
rationale: Members cover scavenging by class A/B/F/H receptors, immune complex clearance, oxLDL responses and foam cell/cholesterol storage, unlike confusables on apoptotic cell clearance or phospholipid catabolism.

qualifier: osmotic stress sensing and aldosterone response
name: Osmotic stress response and regulated sodium and potassium transport
rationale: Members describe osmosensing, hyper/hypotonic and salt responses and aldosterone-driven regulation of Na+/K+ transport, unlike confusables on cation-chloride cotransporter diseases, K+ channels or vasopressin water handling.

qualifier: SWI/SNF BAF complex formation and nucleosome assembly
name: SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling, nucleosome assembly and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine BAF complex assembly, CHD remodelers and nucleosome organization with histone/lysine acetylation, unlike confusables on CENP-A deposition, NuRD/CHD6-9 or stem cell maintenance.

qualifier: activating phagocytosis and inhibitory co-receptor regulation
name: Fc-gamma receptor activating and inhibitory signaling in phagocytosis
rationale: Members cover FCGR activation, phagocytic cup formation, ADCC, hypersensitivity and inhibitory FcR/CD22/SIRP regulation, unlike confusables on BCR signaling, Fc-epsilon mast cell activation or neutrophil inflammation.

qualifier: thymocyte proliferation and survival
name: Hematopoietic stem cell and thymocyte proliferation homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, bone marrow cell survival and immature thymocyte proliferation and apoptosis, unlike confusables on bone marrow development, B cell differentiation or thymic selection.
